description: We have a vibe coding problem. Researchers reviewed 380,000 assets built with AI tools. Of the ~5,000 built for corporate use, 40% expose sensitive data. Meanwhile, marketing, sales, and design teams at the best companies are already shipping app updates with AI, whether IT knows or not. The tools aren't the issue. The environment is. That's why my company runs on Superblocks. Our internal dashboard (videos, sponsorships, revenue, approvals) is vibe coded. But an editor can update a video without ever touching our financials, because permissions live on the data, not just the tab. Company login, role-based access, audit logs. The app and the database run inside our own AWS account. And before anything publishes, it scans for security issues. I hit fix all, it ships. Most vibe coded apps die as prototypes because there's no path to production. This is the path. If you're bringing vibe coding to your company, check out Superblocks. Link in bio. @superblocks #superblockspartner #vibecoding
